title: InvisFrames - Invisible Item Frames
description: Adds craftable invisible item frames to Minecraft.
body:
**Adds craftable invisible item frames to Minecraft.**

- Crafted with glass and an item frame
- Holding an invisible item frame will highlight all other invisible frames that have been placed _within a 10 block radius_

![Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4a7eab5987183f79a66f65a0f66573d7ab245b9a.png)
